modules.module_title: Select a site with suitable conditions for growing large cardamom

pcs.pc_description: Research and identify potential areas available for large cardamom cultivation.
Analyse the altitude, slope, rainfall, humidity, climatic events and ambient air temperature for selecting an area for the cultivation of large cardamom.
Get the soil tested from authorized centres.

Determine if soil conditions are suitable for growing large cardamom. (Soil conditions: fertility of the soil, the nature of the subsoil, soil depth, land topography and its effect on water flow, no contamination in the soil such as heavy metals or pollutants, etc.)
Analyse the availability of compatible shade trees in the selected area.
Identify primary and secondary sources of water and the quality of water available at the site.

modules.module_title: Prepare area for large cardamom cultivation

pcs.pc_description: Identify the hazards of growing large cardamom and possible precautions to take.

Design the layout of the farm providing windbreaks, plantation area as well as other necessary facilities like water source, office space, nursery, irrigation channels, shade trees, roads, fence, etc.
Clear the site of unwanted plant material and general debris without burning organic matter.

Return to the topsoil, the crop residue and other organic farm materials such as green manure, organic mulches and poultry/cattle manure in judicious proportions to replace nutrients removed in the previous harvest.
Interpret scale plans to identify dimensions, shapes and positions to be marked on the land and features to be produced.

Transfer various dimensions accurately from scale plans onto the land, using triangulation, running lines and offsets. (Various dimensions: geometric shapes such as rectangles, circles, hexagons, and ellipses, construction of right angle, irregular shapes)
Organise as per plan for facilities like water supply station, electricity, compost pit, fencing, etc.
Co-ordinate with the vendor for installation and integration of water supply systems such as sprinkler or drip irrigation system.
Determine soil type e.g., clay loam, sandy loam as well as soil texture, structure, pH and land conditions.
Manage soil acidity by applying liming materials, primarily ground limestone.
Ascertain soil preparation techniques and organic soil improvement needs.
Apply primary cultivation methods to prepare the land for planting safely and as planned. (Primary Cultivation: ploughing, harrowing, digging, etc.)
Apply secondary cultivation methods to prepare the land for planting safely and as planned. (Secondary cultivation: hoeing, raking, levelling, consolidation, fertilising and mulching).
Perform traditional methods for land preparation such as clearing the land, pit preparation, topsoil preparation, etc.
Plant compatible shade trees with proper spacing to provide uniform shade in the area for the plantation well ahead of the plantation.

modules.module_title: Prepare primary and secondary nurseries for propagating large cardamom through seeds

pcs.pc_description: Prepare and weather seed beds for the primary nursery.
Mix organic manure into the soil.
Make a surface bed of fine tilth.
Isolate and protect the nursery from fresh infection.
Sow seeds in adequate numbers with adequate distance between them.
Cover seeds with fine soil and mulch.
Water the soil at appropriate intervals to keep the beds moist.
Remove and re-mulch after germinations in the interspace between the rows.
Erect shade pandals to protect germinations.
Identify and remove the seedlings that are ready for transplantation from the primary nursery into the secondary nursery.
Prepare appropriate beds and soil for the secondary nursery.
Transplant seedlings from the primary to the secondary nursery.
Identify and remove the seedlings that are ready for transplantation from the secondary nursery into the field.
Prepare transplantation calendar as per the large cardamom varieties selected and climatic and geographic conditions.
Prepare a transplantation plan for the large cardamom variety such as location, timing, spacing, etc.

Select seedlings in an appropriate condition for transplanting (Appropriate condition: growth of 45-60 cm in height with 2-3 tillers, moist roots / root-ball, free from pests and diseases, free from physical damage, containerised and container grown plants, firm in the pot but not root-bound, even grade / typical features, etc.)
Plant the seedlings as per the transplanting plan using appropriate techniques and systems.
Ensure adequate planting distance and depth based on the requirements of the large cardamom variety, rainfall, soil type and fertility, etc.
Provide immediate aftercare for new plantings. (Immediate aftercare: Watering, supporting/staking, mulching, weed control as appropriate to requirements, soil conditions and time of year).
Select high-yielding, disease-free planting material in the form of one mature tiller with two immature tiller or vegetative buds to be used as planting
Set up a nursery at an appropriate distance from the main plantation
Prepare trenches with adequate depth and distance from each other
Prepare and apply organic topsoil suitable for the propagation of suckers
Plant the planting units at an adequate distance in the planting season and provide aftercare
